requirement: FinTech customer data masking using Pydantic V2 @model_serializer(mode="wrap") accepting (self, handler, info: SerializationInfo) for roles admin, auditor, and public.
skeleton: Pydantic v2 BaseModel with wrap-mode model serializer extracting context safely and masking sensitive customer fields.

rationale.teaches: A wrap-mode model_serializer with the (self, handler, info) signature that reads role from info.context safely and masks by role, defaulting to the least privileged view.
rationale.why: Serialization context is easy to get almost right: the wrong signature raises at class creation, an or-chain always takes the admin branch, and the wrong default leaks everything when no context is passed. Each is one dump call away from being observed.

candidates.why_wrong: info.context is dereferenced without a None check, so model_dump without context raises AttributeError.
The serializer omits the info parameter, so it can never see the role and always emits the same view.
The condition role == admin or auditor is always true, so every role receives the unmasked admin view.
The mask keeps the first four card digits instead of the last four, exposing the issuer prefix and breaking the expected format.
A missing role defaults to admin, so a dump without context returns unmasked data.
